articles.title: California’s coastal communities on alert as biggest waves in years hit state
articles.description:
Hazard warnings issued throughout week after powerful swells and waves of more than 9 metres recorded
Multiple coastal hazard warnings were issued this week across California as successive areas of low pressure generated powerful swells and large breaking waves for coastal communities. Beaches and piers were closed last weekend as large waves crashed into California’s coastline. Offshore National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration buoys recorded wave heights of greater than 30ft (9 metres) last Friday. The Monterey, California, buoy recorded a wave height of 34.1ft, which would make it the highest reading in 30 years.
Coastal warnings extended from last weekend through this week, with alerts extending until Friday night. Waves of 10-18ft are expected, with local sets of 18-22ft for San Luis Obispo county beaches and Santa Barbara county central coast beaches. These Pacific storm systems are also bringing unsettled conditions across the western US, with heavy rain, mountain snow, and strong winds through the coming days. Already, record-breaking rainfall affected San Fransisco on Wednesday, with heavy rain also causing 32,000 customers to lose power in Sacramento. Into this weekend, a further area of low pressure will bring considerable amounts of moisture for southern Oregon and northern California. By Sunday night, more than 100mm (4in) of rain is expected in places, with further snowfall for areas such as Donner Pass across the northern Sierra Nevada mountains.

articles.description: Pasvill Lummer says children growing up in the 60s had a very different experience to their parents.
articles.titleJa: ウィンドラッシュの子供たちがウルヴァーハンプトンをどのように形成したか
articles.summary: パスヴィル・ラマーは、60年代に育った子供たちが親とは全く異なる経験をしたと語る。ウィンドラッシュ世代の子供たちが都市に与えた影響。

articles.title: King relishes 'politically charged' deployments, Palace aide says
articles.description: The monarch faced questions on the UK's involvement in the slave trade during his Caribbean tour.
articles.titleJa: 国王、パレス補佐官が「政治的に帯電した」任務を喜ぶと語る
articles.summary: 国王はカリブ海ツアー中に、英国の奴隷貿易への関与について質問を受けた。パレス補佐官は国王がこのような任務を喜んでいると述べた。

articles.title: How medical neglect killed Alfredo Díaz in a Venezuelan cell
articles.description: Despite government shifts, a UN report confirms Venezuela's repressive system remains active, documenting how medical neglect in state custody led to the death of regional leader and politician Alfredo Díaz.
articles.titleJa: 医療過失によりベネズエラの独房でアルフレド・ディアスが死亡した経緯
articles.summary: 国連報告書は、ベネズエラの抑圧的なシステムが依然として活動しており、政治家アルフレド・ディアスの医療過失による死を記録していると確認した。

articles.title: Ecuadorian youth unite against neoliberal models and state violence
articles.description: Thousands of Ecuadorian students have taken to the streets to reject President Noboa’s temporary job plans, demanding permanent solutions for public healthcare, education funding, and rising insecurity.
articles.titleJa: エクアドルの若者が新自由主義モデルと国家暴力に反対して団結
articles.summary: エクアドルの学生たちは、ノボア大統領の雇用計画を拒否し、医療、教育、治安に関する恒久的な解決策を要求するために街頭に出た。

articles.title: Beyond the beaches: The Dominican Republic and the global debate over deep-sea mining
articles.description: The DR wanted science to keep advancing and the International Seabed Authority to finish building the regulatory framework that the UN Convention had mandated it to develop.
articles.titleJa: ビーチを越えて：ドミニカ共和国と深海採掘をめぐる世界的な議論
articles.summary: ドミニカ共和国は、科学の進歩と国際海底機構による規制枠組みの完成を望んでおり、深海採掘に関する世界的な議論が続いている。

articles.title: Venezuela welcomes opposition leader María Corina Machado home
articles.description: Venezuela’s Nobel laureate María Corina Machado returned to Caracas in a massive celebration after months in hiding and exile, sparking deep hope and sharp questions about the country’s political future.
articles.titleJa: ベネズエラ、野党指導者マリア・コリーナ・マチャドの帰国を歓迎
articles.summary: ベネズエラの野党指導者マリア・コリーナ・マチャドが亡命から帰国し、大々的に歓迎されたことで、国の政治的未来に大きな期待と疑問が湧いている。

articles.title: What comes after networked authoritarianism?
articles.description: October’s spotlight on Big Tech and Authoritarianism explored a range of relationships between tech companies and political actors across the global majority.
articles.titleJa: ネットワーク型権威主義の次に何が来るのか？
articles.summary: 10月の特集では、ビッグテックと権威主義に焦点を当て、世界中のテクノロジー企業と政治的行為者の関係を探求した。

articles.title: The scandals and suspects surrounding Flávio Bolsonaro, according to the Brazilian press
articles.description: The former president's eldest son, Flávio, had been linked to embezzlement charges in his own cabinet. During the campaign, however, his resume was exposed even further
articles.titleJa: ブラジル報道機関によるフラビオ・ボルソナーロをめぐるスキャンダルと容疑者たち
articles.summary: 元大統領の長男フラビオは、自身の内閣での横領容疑と関連付けられており、キャンペーン中にその経歴がさらに露呈した。

articles.title: The Brazilian left’s quest to ‘tame’ Meta: A narrative of denouncement and resistance
articles.description: In our October edition of Undertones, we examine a movement calling for accountability and coordinated online action to challenge Meta’s problematic content moderation policies and governance practices in Brazil.
articles.titleJa: ブラジル左派のメタ「飼いならし」への探求：非難と抵抗の物語
articles.summary: ブラジルでは、Metaのコンテンツモデレーションとガバナンス慣行に異議を唱える運動が、説明責任とオンライン連携行動を求めている。

articles.title: How the streets and a social media army led Lula to a historic win in Brazil
articles.description: After ending the first round 2.2 million votes behind his opponent, Flávio Bolsonaro, Lula won the election with a difference of 4 million votes, and will serve a fourth term as president
articles.titleJa: 街頭とソーシャルメディア軍がルラをブラジルでの歴史的勝利に導いた経緯
articles.summary: ルラは、対抗馬に220万票差をつけられながらも、400万票差で選挙に勝利し、4期目の大統領を務めることになった。

articles.title: Warning Signals: Venezuela and the Risk of AI-Powered Chinese Digital Authoritarianism
articles.description: A report by the Australian think tank ASPI warns that Venezuela could integrate Chinese artificial intelligence into its surveillance system and expand its digital control capabilities.
articles.titleJa: 警鐘：ベネズエラとAIを搭載した中国のデジタル権威主義のリスク
articles.summary: 報告書によると、ベネズエラは中国のAIを監視システムに統合し、デジタル制御能力を拡大する可能性があると警告されている。

articles.title: Queer mediums of the cult of María Lionza are redefining the gender binary in Venezuela’s sacred mountain
articles.description: An ethnographic look at Venezuela's María Lionza cult, examining how LGBTQ+ mediums challenge traditional gender roles and face discrimination while channeling diverse spiritual entities
articles.titleJa: マリア・リオンザ崇拝のクィアな霊媒師たちがベネズエラの聖なる山でジェンダーバイナリを再定義
articles.summary: ベネズエラのマリア・リオンザ崇拝に関する民族誌学的研究で、LGBTQ+霊媒師たちが伝統的なジェンダー役割に挑戦し、差別を受けながらも多様な霊的実体をチャネリングしている。

articles.title: These dead pets were meant to be cremated - then their bodies appeared on a livestream
articles.description: Grieving Filipinos confront a distressing reality: their dogs and cats may not have received the send-off they paid for.
articles.titleJa: 火葬されるはずだったペットの遺体が生配信に登場
articles.summary: 悲しみに暮れるフィリピン人たちが、費用を支払ったペットの火葬が行われなかったという悲痛な現実に直面。

articles.title: A new Nepal, an old neighbour - Balendra Shah's India test on first visit
articles.description: Trade, connectivity and regional cooperation will be on top of the agenda when Nepal's PM meets his India counterpart.
articles.titleJa: 新しいネパール、古い隣人 — バレンドラ・シャーの初訪問におけるインドとの試練
articles.summary: ネパール首相のインド訪問では、貿易、接続性、地域協力が主要議題となる見込み。

articles.title: Bowen: Myanmar genocide verdict is historic and could have far-reaching implications
articles.description: Lawyers will study the way in which The Gambia proved the crucial point that Myanmar intended to commit genocide, writes the BBC's international editor.
articles.titleJa: ボーウェン氏：ミャンマーのジェノサイド判決は歴史的で広範な影響を及ぼす可能性
articles.summary: 弁護士たちは、ガンビアがミャンマーのジェノサイド意図を証明した方法を研究するだろうとBBCの国際編集者が語る。

articles.title: South Korea catches 111 students with new measures against exam cheating
articles.description: The students were caught with banned smart devices while taking the high-stakes Suneung exam.
articles.titleJa: 韓国、大学入試での不正行為対策で111人の学生を摘発
articles.summary: 厳格な大学入学共通テスト「スヌン」で、禁止されたスマートデバイスを使用していた学生111人が逮捕された。

articles.title: Indonesian daycare principal jailed for five years over child abuse case
articles.description: Toddlers were found with their hands and feet tied with rags when police raided the centre in April.
articles.titleJa: インドネシアの保育園園長、児童虐待事件で禁固5年の判決
articles.summary: 4月に警察が施設を捜索した際、幼児たちが布で手足を縛られているのが発見された。

articles.title: China issues Mount Fuji warning as family of missing climber offers reward
articles.description: The $75,000 reward offered by Chen Jie's family has sparked fears of more reckless climbing attempts.
articles.titleJa: 中国が富士山警告を発令、不明の登山者家族が報奨金を提供
articles.summary: チェン・ジエさんの家族が提供した7万5000ドルの報奨金が、無謀な登山増加の懸念を引き起こしている。

articles.title: Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya minority, top UN court rules
articles.description: The unprecedented International Court of Justice verdict concerns a 2017 military crackdown that killed thousands.
articles.titleJa: ミャンマーがロヒンギャ少数民族に対してジェノサイドを実行、国連最高裁が判決
articles.summary: 国際司法裁判所による前例のない判決は、数千人が死亡した2017年の軍事弾圧に関するもの。

articles.title: Cumin-laced fizzy sodas are giving cola giants a tough fight in India
articles.description: Cumin-laced sodas are capturing a bigger market share in India as demand for homegrown flavours goes up.
articles.titleJa: クミン風味の炭酸飲料がインドでコーラ大手に激戦を挑む
articles.summary: インドでは国産フレーバーへの需要が高まり、クミン風味の炭酸飲料が市場シェアを拡大している。

articles.title: Indian driver wins $1.3m in life-changing lottery prize
articles.description: A truck driver's fortunes have changed overnight after he won a Diwali lottery in the northern Indian state of Punjab.
articles.titleJa: インド人運転手が130万ドルの人生を変える宝くじに当選
articles.summary: インド北部パンジャブ州で、トラック運転手がディワリ宝くじに当選し、一夜にして運命が変わった。

articles.title: William and Kate meet PM Modi as they wrap up India tour
articles.description: The meeting in New Delhi was a late addition to the royal couple's India visit, which also included their appearance at the annual Earthshot Prize
articles.titleJa: ウィリアム王子とキャサリン妃がモディ首相と会談、インド訪問を締めくくる
articles.summary: ニューデリーでの会談は、ロイヤル夫妻のインド訪問に後から追加されたもので、アースショット賞も含まれた。

articles.title: Panama submits request to join Expansion of the Information Technology Agreement
articles.description: Panama has submitted a request to join the 2015 Expansion of the Information Technology Agreement (ITA II), the Chair of the Committee of Participants on the Expansion of Trade in Information Technology Products, Mr Shih-Chun Weng of Chinese Taipei, informed members at a meeting on 19 November. Panama said joining ITA II will help it to advance its goal of a more knowledge-based, innovation-driven and technologically advanced economy.
articles.titleJa: パナマが情報技術協定拡大への参加申請を提出
articles.summary: パナマは、知識ベース経済への移行を目指し、情報技術協定拡大（ITA II）への参加をWTOに申請しました。

articles.title: Applications open for WIPO-WTO Executive Programme on Intellectual Property Issues
articles.description: The Secretariat of the World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO) and the Secretariat of the World Trade Organization (WTO) are now accepting applications for the WIPO-WTO Executive Programme on Intellectual Property Issues for Senior Government Officials. The activity will take place from 1 to 12 February 2027 at the headquarters of the WIPO and of the WTO in Geneva, Switzerland.
articles.titleJa: WIPO-WTO知的財産問題幹部プログラムの参加者募集開始
articles.summary: WIPOとWTOが、知的財産問題に関する上級政府職員向け幹部プログラムの参加者募集を開始しました。2027年2月にジュネーブで開催されます。

articles.title: Spotlight on trade fundamentals at annual WTO student event
articles.description: Over 200 students joined policymakers, executives and thought leaders on 18 November at the WTO to discuss trade fundamentals at the WTO's annual student-only event on trade, titled WTO 101: Trade Rules!. Now in its third year, the event saw spirited discussions on the key issues facing the multilateral system and its implications for the next generation.
articles.titleJa: WTO年次学生イベントで貿易の基礎に焦点
articles.summary: 200人以上の学生がWTO年次イベント「WTO 101: 貿易ルール！」に参加し、多角的貿易システムが直面する主要課題について活発な議論を交わしました。

articles.title: Trade Policy Review: Peru
articles.description: The sixth review of the trade policies and practices of Peru takes place on 18 and 20 November 2026. The basis for the review is a report by the WTO Secretariat and a report by the Government of Peru.
articles.titleJa: 貿易政策レビュー：ペルー
articles.summary: ペルーの貿易政策と慣行に関する第6回レビューが2026年11月18日と20日に開催されます。WTO事務局とペルー政府の報告書に基づきます。

articles.title: New trade-restrictive measures surge but WTO members step up trade facilitation efforts
articles.description: The pace of newly-introduced tariffs and other non-facilitating measures rose sharply in the first half of 2026, while the stockpile of such measures reached a record level, according to the WTO Director-General's latest annual overview of developments in the international trading environment. At the same time, WTO members introduced a significant number of trade-facilitating measures, helping to sustain global trade flows despite heightened geopolitical tensions and economic uncertainty.
articles.titleJa: 新たな貿易制限措置が急増も、WTO加盟国は貿易円滑化努力を強化
articles.summary: 2026年上半期、新たな貿易制限措置が急増し、累積措置は記録的な水準に。WTO加盟国は貿易円滑化措置を強化し、世界貿易を支えています。

articles.title: DDG Nordquist: Global trade is adapting, not retreating
articles.description: Global trade has demonstrated remarkable resilience despite geopolitical tensions, supply chain disruptions and trade restrictions, with businesses adapting through diversification and new trading partnerships, Deputy Director-General DJ Nordquist said at the 16th Asian Logistics, Maritime and Aviation Conference in Hong Kong, China, on 16 November. Highlighting stronger-than-expected trade growth and the continued importance of WTO rules, she called for more resilient global supply chains, deeper international cooperation and reforms to ensure the multilateral trading system remains fit for today's challenges. The text of her speech is below.
articles.titleJa: ノードキスト事務次長補佐：世界貿易は後退ではなく適応している
articles.summary: ノードキストWTO事務次長補佐は、世界貿易は地政学的緊張や供給網の混乱にもかかわらず適応力を示していると述べ、多様化と新たな貿易パートナーシップを強調しました。

articles.title: Goods Council agrees to modernize notification reporting, reviews trade concerns
articles.description: The WTO's Council for Trade in Goods (CTG) adopted a decision to improve annual reporting on notifications and the WTO Notifications Portal. It also reviewed an updated Secretariat report indicating that 35% of the 241 trade concerns raised in the Council between 1995 and May 2026 had been reported as fully or partially resolved. Members considered 38 trade concerns, including five raised for the first time, and discussed several issues relating to tariff renegotiations under Article XXVIII of the GATT.
articles.titleJa: 物品理事会、通知報告の近代化に合意し貿易懸念をレビュー
articles.summary: WTO物品理事会は通知報告の改善に合意し、貿易懸念38件を検討。1995年以降の貿易懸念の35%が解決済みと報告されました。

articles.title: Ireland contributes EUR 200,000 to strengthen trade opportunities in developing countries
articles.description: Ireland is contributing EUR 200,000 (approximately CHF 185,000) to the Standards and Trade Development Facility (STDF) in 2026 to strengthen sanitary and phytosanitary capacity in developing and least-developed countries. The contribution will support STDF activities that help countries meet international food safety and animal and plant health standards, as well as facilitate safe and inclusive trade.
articles.titleJa: アイルランド、途上国の貿易機会強化に20万ユーロを拠出
articles.summary: アイルランドは、途上国の衛生植物検疫能力強化のため、STDFに20万ユーロを拠出。食品安全基準を満たし、貿易を促進します。

articles.title: Members review LDC support, discuss public health and small business IP assistance
articles.description: At a meeting of the Council for Trade-Related Aspects of Intellectual Property Rights (TRIPS) on 12-13 November, members reviewed special provisions for least developed countries (LDCs) and shared experiences on how governments can implement the TRIPS Agreement, achieve public health objectives, and help small businesses benefit from IP protection. The meeting also concluded the review of IP implementing legislation for Samoa, launched a review of Vanuatu's legislation, and received updates on notifications, pandemic preparedness, and other issues.
articles.titleJa: メンバーがLDC支援、公衆衛生、中小企業IP支援を議論
articles.summary: TRIPS理事会で、後発開発途上国（LDC）への特別規定、公衆衛生目標達成、中小企業へのIP保護支援などが議論されました。

articles.title: South Africa notifies launch of safeguard investigation into certain non-wired float glass products
articles.description: On 11 November 2026, South Africa notified the WTO’s Committee on Safeguards regarding the initiation on 3 November 2026 of a safeguard investigation into imports of certain non-wired float glass products.
articles.titleJa: 南アフリカ、一部の非線入りフロートガラス製品に対するセーフガード調査の開始を通知
articles.summary: 南アフリカは、非線入りフロートガラス製品の輸入に対するセーフガード調査の開始をWTOに通知しました。
